l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.material: Isimangalo: (a+b)²=a²+b² iyiqiniso kunoma yiziphi izinombolo a no-b. Thola u-a no-b abonisa ukuthi lesi simangalo asilungile.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s1.r.c: Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-16, ngakho ziyalingana. Lesi sibonelo sivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s1.r.d: (0+6)²=36 no-0²+6²=36, ngakho ziyalingana. Lesi sibonelo sivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s1.explain: Uma u-a=2 no-b=3, bese (2+3)²=25 no-2²+3²=13, ngakho ziyahlukana.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s2.model.0: (2+3)²=25 kodwa 2²+3²=13, ngakho amanani amabili ayahlukana. Kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s2.model.1: Uma inombolo eyodwa ingu-0, izinhlangothi zombili zenzeka zilingana, kodwa nge-2 ne-3 uthola u-25 no-13, ohlukene. Ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.r.a: U-xy³ unezinga elingu-4, isamba sezikhombisi zika-x no-y. Uma ubheka u-x kuphela, uyawuphuthelwa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.o.c: Okukhulu kakhulu kwamanani owatholayo ngokungeza zonke izikhombisi zezinto eziguquguqukayo kutemu ngalinye
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.explain: U-x²y unezinga elingu-2+1=3 futhi u-xy³ unezinga elingu-1+3=4. Elikhulu kakhulu, u-4, yizinga le-polynomial.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s2.model.0: Ungeza zonke izikhombisi zezinto eziguquguqukayo etemini elilodwa, ngakho u-xy³ unezinga elingu-4, futhi inani elikhulu kakhulu, u-4, yizinga.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s2.model.1: Uma ubheka u-x kuphela, uphuthelwa u-y³ ku-xy³, ngakho izinga yilona elikhulu kakhulu kumanani avela ekungezeni zonke izikhombisi.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.goal: Thola ukuthi yiliphi izinga (ulwazi) elibalulekile ukwazi ukuthi isisho sihlukaniswa ngezinto njengomehluko wezikwele ezimbili, bese ucacisa ukuthi kungani ulikhethile.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.material: U-x²−9y² uhlukaniswa abe ngu-(x+3y)(x−3y). Kodwa u-x²+9y², obonakala ufana, awukwazi ukuhlukaniswa ngendlela efanayo. Thola izinga elihlukanisa ezimbili.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.prompt: Liyini izinga lokwazi ukuthi ungahlukaniswa ngezinto yini?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi uyifomu lomehluko (ukukhipha) wezikwele ezimbili yini
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.b: U-x²+9y² naye unamatemu amabili, kodwa awukwazi ukuhlukaniswa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.c: Izinga akulona uphawu lobumbano kodwa ukuthi kuyifomu lokukhipha yini.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezinto eziguquguqukayo yini
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.d: Noma kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezinto eziguquguqukayo, isamba asikwazi ukuhlukaniswa ngezinto.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.explain: U-A²−B²=(A+B)(A−B), ngakho kumele kube yifomu lokukhipha. U-A²+B² akakwazi ukusebenzisa le fomula.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s2.model.0: I-x²−9y² iwumehluko we-x² no-(3y)², ngakho ihlukaniswa ibe yi-(x+3y)(x−3y), kodwa i-x²+9y² yisamba, ngakho le fomula ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s2.model.1: Ifomula ethi A²−B²=(A+B)(A−B) isebenza ekukhipheni kuphela, ngakho ukuthi ingabe kuwumehluko wezikwele ezimbili yini yindinganiso.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.goal: Thola ukuthi yiliphi izinga (ulwazi) elidingeka ngempela ukuze wazi ukuthi igrafu ka-y=x²−4x+k ihlangana ne-x-axis yini, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani ulikhethile.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s1.r.b: Iphoyinti elihlangana ne-y-axis alikutsheli ukuthi ihlangana ne-x-axis yini.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi igrafu ivulekela phezulu kuphela yini
l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s1.r.c: Isiqondiso sokuvuleka sodwa asikutsheli ukuthi ithinta ne-x-axis yini.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi i-y-coordinate yencopho ingu-0 noma ngaphansi yini
l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s1.explain: Ivulekela phezulu, ngakho uma i-y-coordinate yencopho (2, k−4) ingu-0 noma ngaphansi, ihlangana ne-x-axis. Lokho kusho u-k≤4.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s2.model.0: Incopho iyiphoyinti eliphansi kakhulu, ngakho ihlangana ne-x-axis uma ukuphakama kwayo u-k−4 kungu-0 noma kungaphansi.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-20.s.s2.model.1: Ngisho noma ivulekela phezulu, ayihlangani ne-x-axis uma incopho iphezu kwe-x-axis, ngakho kumele sibheke i-y-coordinate yencopho.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-18.material: Isixazululo: Ukuhlukanisa zombili izinhlangothi zika-x²=3x ngo-x kunika u-x=3. Ukufaka u-x=3 kunika 9=9, okulungile, ngakho isixazululo esisodwa ngu-x=3.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-18.s.s1.o.d: Lapho kuphethwe ngokuthi kunesixazululo esisodwa kuphela
l-m-h1-b0e01a-18.s.s1.r.d: Isizathu sokuthi isiphetho siyaphutha sisekuhlukanisweni esinyathelweni sangaphambilini.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-18.s.s1.explain: Uma u-x=0, ubuzohlukanisa ngo-0 futhi ulahlekelwe yisixazululo u-x=0. Uma u-x(x−3)=0, khona-ke u-x=0 noma u-3.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-18.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-x=0, ubuzohlukanisa zombili izinhlangothi ngo-0, okungakwazi ukwenziwa. Ukuxazulula ngo-x(x−3)=0 kunika u-0 no-3.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-18.s.s2.model.1: Ngenxa yokuhlukanisa, isixazululo u-x=0 sanyamalala. Kufanele uhambise konke ohlangothini olulodwa njengo-x²−3x=0 bese uhlukanisa ngezinto.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo sokuthola i-y-intercept etafuleni, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, uthole indawo yokuqala ephutha, futhi uyilungise.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.material: Isixazululo somsebenzi olinganayo lapho u-y engu-5, 7, 9 uma u-x engu-1, 2, 3: Umugqa 1: Uma u-x enyuka ngo-1, u-y unyuka ngo-2. Umugqa 2: Uma x=0, y=5+2=7. Umugqa 3: Ngakho y=2x+7.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.s.s1.r.b: Uma u-x eba mncane, u-y naye uba mncane. Ku-x=0, u-y mncane kunaku-x=1.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.s.s1.r.c: 5, 7, 9 kunyuka ngo-2 isikhathi ngasinye. Lokho kulungile.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kuwumphumela wokusebenzisa u-7 emugqeni wangaphambilini. Umugqa wangaphambilini ubuphutha kuqala.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.s.s1.explain: U-x=0 mncane kunaku-x=1, ngakho y=5−2=3. Isibalo singu-y=2x+3.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.s.s2.model.0: U-x=0 uncane ngo-1 kunaku-x=1, ngakho u-y naye mncane ngo-2, 5−2=3, kodwa kubalwe njengo-+2, ngakho umugqa 2 uphutha.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-47.s.s2.model.1: Ukufaka u-x=1 ku-y=2x+3 kunika u-5, ngakho kulungile. Ngakho lungisa umugqa 2 ube ngu-3.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.title: Iphutha lokuqala esixazululweni esifunda inani eliphezulu kakhulu nomugqa wokuhambisana etafuleni
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo senani eliphezulu kakhulu nomugqa wokuhambisana ka-y=−x²+6x, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, uthole indawo yokuqala ephutha, futhi uyilungise.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.material: Ithebula lika-y=−x²+6x: uma u-x engu-0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, u-y ungu-0, 5, 8, 9, 8, 5, 0. Isixazululo: Umugqa 1: Inani elikhulu kakhulu lika-y ngu-9. Umugqa 2: Khona-ke x=3. Umugqa 3: Igrafu ihambisana kwesokunxele nakwesokudla ngo-y=9.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.s.s1.r.b: Inani elikhulu kakhulu lika-y etafuleni ngempela ngu-9.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.s.s1.r.d: Izinga lokuhambisana kwesokunxele nakwesokudla ngu-x=3, okunika inani lika-x.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wokuhambisana yinani ohlangothini lwe-x, ngakho ungu-x=3. U-y=9 yinani eliphezulu kakhulu.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.s.s2.model.0: Kuyahambisana kwesokunxele nakwesokudla, ngakho umugqa ungumugqa oqondile u-x=3, kodwa kubhalwe u-y=9, ngakho umugqa 3 uphutha.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-48.s.s2.model.1: Etafuleni amanani ku-x=2 no-4 ayalingana, ngakho maphakathi, u-x=3, ungumugqa wokuhambisana.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.goal: Guqula izixazululo zika-x²−x−6=0 zibe ngenye indlela (inkulumo, ithebula, isithombe, amazwi), bese ucacisa ukuthi kungani zisho into efanayo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.material: x²−x−6=(x−3)(x+2), ngakho izixazululo zesibalo x²−x−6=0 zingu-3 no-−2. Sho lezi zixazululo ngokwegrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic y=x²−x−6.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.r.a: I-vertex iphakathi ncamashi kwezixazululo ezimbili, ku-x=0.5.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.o.b: Ukuxhumanisa kuka-y kwephoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-y-axis
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.r.b: Lapho ihlangana khona ne-y-axis yinani ku-x=0, okungu-−6.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.o.c: Ukuxhumanisa kuka-x kwamaphoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.explain: U-x lapho y=0 uyisixazululo sesibalo. Yizixhumanisi zika-x zamaphoyinti (3,0) no-(−2,0) lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s2.model.0: Isibalo x²−x−6=0 sicala lika-y=0, ngakho izixhumanisi zika-x zamaphoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis yizixazululo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s2.model.1: Uma ufaka u-x=3, khona-ke u-y=0, ngakho iphoyinti (3,0) lisegrafini. Yingakho isixazululo siyisixhumanisi sika-x sephoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis.
